title: the best sunset of my trip
text: One of the most beautiful sunsets I have seen in Barcelona!! seeing it from the sea was a very lovely experience that I would definitely repeat with this team. Thanks to Agostima who was super attentive to us 🙏🏻🩵
author: B8525FKguadalupes

title: Such a beautiful evening!
text:
We had such a good time! The sunset was honestly amazing and seeing Barcelona from the sea was so beautiful. The atmosphere on the boat was super relaxed and fun, and it was such a nice way to spend the evening.
Definitely recommend it if you want to do something a little different while in Barcelona. 💛
author: agom53

title: Fantastic experience
text:
Fantastic experience

Host and captain Carlos were brilliant

author: Ceri_J

title: Sailing in bacelona
text: It was fantastic! The cruise was relaxing and the staff was very attentive. The boat gave a different perspectives to the city which was very nice.
author: SARALYN_D

title: A peaceful night of sailing
text: It was a beautiful night.  The sailor was very nice .  The sight of Barcelona from the sea was great.  He had a pleasant personality and was very informative.
author: Janet_K

title: Beautiful Sunset Cruise
text: The tour was lovely. Everything was very simple and the company provided excellent instructions and directions. We toured the harbor, drank wine, snacked, and enjoyed lovely Barcelona views from the Mediterranean.
author: jennifersI5768AJ

title: Fun, social, sunset cruise!
text: Such a great way to meet new people from all over and get out on the water! The hosts were so kind, helpful, and fun!
author: Jill_S

title: Fabulous Sunset Cruise
text: Albert was outstanding, as was Alice. Snacks were more than expected. Loved our sunset cruise. Highly recommend this to everyone!
author: Nicole T

title: Highly Recommend
text: The sunset cruise exceeded my expectations. The crew (Alice and the Captain) were very nice and accommodating and the entertainment was amazing! The combination of singer with her angelic voice, the acoustic guitar and beautiful sunset made for a perfect evening.
author: cstephens1971
